This Petition Coming On For Orders, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The accused in Special Case No.292/2022 pending before the Court of Additional District and Sessions Judge FTSC-I, Belagavi arising out of Crime No.339/2022 registered by Athani Police Station, Belagavi for the offences punishable under Sections 376(3), 376(2)(n), 376(2)(f) of IPC and Sections 5(j)(2), 4 and 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (for short 'POCSO Act') is before this Court under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. seeking regular bail.

sentences.text: 2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1.
Respondent No.2 though served in the matter has remained unrepresented before this Court.

NC: 2024:KHC-D:9852 3. FIR in Crime No.339/2022 registered by Athani Police Station, Belagavi against the petitioner herein for the aforesaid offences on the basis of the first information received from respondent No.2 herein.
During the course of investigation, the petitioner herein was arrested on 15.10.2022 and remanded to judicial custody.
The investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.

The bail application filed by the petitioner before this Court earlier in Criminal Petition No.102566/2023 was dismissed as not pressed with liberty to the petitioner to approach this Court afresh after examination of the victim/CW.7 is completed before the Trial Court.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the victim as well as her mother have been examined in the present case as PW.1 and PW.2 and they have not supported the case of the Shri Sachin S/O Manohar Boraganvi vs The State Of Karnataka on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100558602/
2 prosecution.

sentences.text: He accordingly, prays to allow the petition.
Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader appearing for respondent No.1 has opposed the petition, however, he does not dispute the submission made by learned counsel for the petitioner.
6. The material on record would go to show that the first informant, who is the mother of the victim girl has been examined in the present case as PW.1 and the victim girl is examined as PW.2.
PW.1 and PW.2 both have turned hostile to the case of the prosecution.
Though they are cross-examined by the Public Prosecutor, nothing material has been elicited from their mouth, which is incriminating as against the petitioner.
Having regard to the evidence of PW.2, a serious doubt arises with regard to the correctness of her age as alleged in the charge sheet.
The petitioner, who is aged about 24 years, is in custody from 15.10.2022.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of bail requires to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following order is passed:
NC: 2024:KHC-D:9852 ORDER
The petition is allowed.
